text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер finishes the Japanese
Derby
admirably.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Frustrated with how the race played out,
El
Condor Pasa challenges her to a
rematch at the
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But this would warrant a change in our
agenda.
While Грасс Вандер ponders
the idea, we're
approached by
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She taunts Грасс Вандер by saying El
Condor
Pasa may be more deserving of
the moniker
"Beast's Successor," then
leaves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not one to take that lying down, Grass
Wonder
decides to accept El Condor
Pasa's challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
